resources.string: On-Device Image Metadata & C2PA Content Credentials Inspector & Sanitizer
Missing C2PA Content Credentials do not prove that an image is authentic, unedited, or human-created. They only indicate that no embedded C2PA manifest was found inside this file container.

External manifests stored in remote provenance registries and imperceptible pixel-level watermarks (such as Google SynthID or frequency-domain steganography) reside outside file metadata headers and are not removed by metadata cleaning.

Removing C2PA Content Credentials strips cryptographic provenance history from the exported copy and may prevent third-party tools from verifying the original creation or editing lineage of the exported image. Your original source file remains untouched.
